classification.difficultyReason: Use perimeter to express one side in terms of the other, then form and factorise an area equation.

content.prompt: The perimeter of a rectangular field is $500\text{ m}$ and its area is $14\,400\text{ m}^2$. Find the lengths of the sides.

answer.worked:
Let one side be $x\text{ m}$ and the other be $y\text{ m}$.

$$\begin{align*}2x+2y&=500\\x+y&=250\\y&=250-x\end{align*}$$

Using the area:

$$\begin{align*}x(250-x)&=14\,400\\250x-x^2&=14\,400\\x^2-250x+14\,400&=0\\(x-90)(x-160)&=0\\x&=90\text{ or }x=160\end{align*}$$

The corresponding other side is $160\text{ m}$ or $90\text{ m}$. Hence the sides are $90\text{ m}$ and $160\text{ m}$.

Check: $2(90+160)=500\text{ m}$ and $90\times160=14\,400\text{ m}^2$.
